title: Zebra with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="18" fill="#f4f4f4"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="74" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#f4f4f4"/>
  <rect x="42" y="76" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f4f4f4"/>
  <rect x="54" y="76" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f4f4f4"/>
  <rect x="66" y="74" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#f4f4f4"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="29" y="89" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5a5a7a"/>
  <rect x="41" y="89" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5a5a7a"/>
  <rect x="53" y="89" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5a5a7a"/>
  <rect x="65" y="89" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5a5a7a"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <polygon points="68,58 82,34 88,38 76,64" fill="#f4f4f4"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="32" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#f4f4f4" transform="rotate(-15 82 32)"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="91" cy="38" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#c8c8e0" transform="rotate(-15 91 38)"/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx="92" cy="37" r="1.2" fill="#6a6a8a"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#6a6a8a"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="20" rx="3.5" ry="7" fill="#f4f4f4" transform="rotate(-25 74 20)"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="20.5" rx="1.8" ry="4.5" fill="#e0a0b0" transform="rotate(-25 74 20)"/>
  <ellipse cx="84" cy="18" rx="3.5" ry="7" fill="#f4f4f4" transform="rotate(10 84 18)"/>
  <ellipse cx="84" cy="18.5" rx="1.8" ry="4.5" fill="#e0a0b0" transform="rotate(10 84 18)"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <polygon points="70,26 64,22 69,34 62,32 68,42 60,42 66,50" fill="#5a5a7a"/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d="M34,50 Q40,58 34,66" stroke="#5a5a7a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44,48 Q50,58 44,68" stroke="#5a5a7a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54,47 Q60,58 54,68" stroke="#5a5a7a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64,50 Q70,58 64,66" stroke="#5a5a7a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- neck stripes -->
  <path d="M72,52 Q80,44 86,36" stroke="#5a5a7a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M76,58 Q84,50 88,42" stroke="#5a5a7a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes (big and bright) -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="29" r="4" fill="#ffe860"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="29" r="2.2" fill="#ffb020"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="29" r="1.1" fill="#4a2800"/>
  <circle cx="83.4" cy="27.6" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- extra sparkles around right eye -->
  <path d="M88,24 L89,26 L91,25 L90,27 L92,28 L90,29 L91,31 L89,30 L88,32 L87,30 L85,31 L86,29 L84,28 L86,27 L85,25 L87,26 Z" fill="#fff7a0"/>
  <circle cx="77" cy="26" r="1" fill="#fff7a0"/>
  <circle cx="87" cy="33" r="0.8" fill="#fff7a0"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M24,56 Q16,50 14,58 Q12,66 18,64 Q16,70 22,66" stroke="#5a5a7a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="57" r="3" fill="#5a5a7a"/>
</svg>
